description: Eight-step pitch sequencer clocked from outside, with an octave knob and a semitone knob for each step

params.text: Sets the octave of that step, snapping to whole numbers 1 to 8; 4 gives 0V and each number above it adds a volt, so the range is -3V to 4V
Sets the semitone for that step, snapping to whole numbers 0 to 11, and adds that many twelfths of a volt to that step's octave voltage

inputs.text: Each rise past 1.7V moves on to the next step and sets NOTE OUT to that step's pitch
A rise past 1.7V makes the next clock play step 1

outputs.text: The pitch of the step now playing, held until the next clock; nothing is output before the first clock arrives

notes: the twelve semitones are stored rounded to two decimal places, so a step can be up to 4 cents away from equal temperament
NOTE OUT carries 0V until the first clock arrives; turning the knobs on their own changes nothing
the lamp beside a step is lit while that step is playing
the place in the sequence is not written into the patch file, so the first clock after a patch is loaded plays step 1
